rubrics.name: General Rubrics
rubrics.description: General rubric for evaluating standard engineering and physics problem-solving responses

dimensions.name: Problem Framing
dimensions.description: Ability to correctly interpret the question, identify the relevant topic or principle, establish appropriate assumptions and reference conventions, and articulate an initial qualitative expectation before proceeding to detailed solution steps.

criterias.name: Correct identification of the task
criterias.scoring_condition: Clearly paraphrases the question in a way that correctly identifies the goal

criterias.name: Recognition of relevant topic/principle
criterias.scoring_condition: The student correctly identifies the relevant topic or governing principle

criterias.name: Stating simplifying assumptions
criterias.description: What is being or what should be idealised or neglected
criterias.scoring_condition: At least one reasonable simplifying assumption is explicitly stated

criterias.name: Reference frame / sign convention
criterias.description: How quantities are defined (e.g. coordinate system, radian convention)
criterias.scoring_condition: A coordinate system, direction, sign convention, or reference point is clearly defined AND used consistently

criterias.name: Early qualitative expectation
criterias.scoring_condition: The student states a qualitative expectation about behaviour, trend, or sign

dimensions.name: Solution Execution
dimensions.description: Ability to set up equations, apply relevant principles, and progress through the solution in a clear, logically ordered manner.

criterias.name: Correct equation setup
criterias.description: Governing equations correctly represent the problem
criterias.scoring_condition: The student writes down equations that correctly follow from the identified principles and assumptions

criterias.name: Logical progression of steps
criterias.description: Solution proceeds in a coherent order
criterias.scoring_condition: Steps follow a logical sequence without unexplained jumps

criterias.name: Use of intermediate results
criterias.description: Intermediate quantities are derived and used appropriately
criterias.scoring_condition: No step contradicts previously stated assumptions

criterias.name: Consistent application of assumptions
criterias.description: Assumptions are respected throughout the solution
criterias.scoring_condition: No step contradicts previously stated assumptions

criterias.name: Completion of solution method
criterias.scoring_condition: The student reaches a solvable equation or final expression

dimensions.name: Technical Correctness
dimensions.description: Correctness of equations, algebra, units, and final results, allowing for minor non-fatal slips that do not undermine the overall approach.

criterias.name: Correct equations
criterias.scoring_condition: Equations are dimensionally and conceptually correct

criterias.name: Algebraic accuracy
criterias.scoring_condition: No major algebraic or sign errors are present

criterias.name: Unit consistency
criterias.scoring_condition: Units are correct or internally consistent throughout

criterias.name: Correct final result
criterias.scoring_condition: The final result follows logically from previous steps

criterias.name: Error severity
criterias.scoring_condition: Any errors present do not invalidate the overall approach

dimensions.name: Communication & Whiteboard Use
dimensions.description: Clarity of verbal explanation and effective use of the online whiteboard (diagrams, labels, readable working) to externalise and support reasoning.

criterias.name: Verbal clarity
criterias.scoring_condition: The interviewer can follow the reasoning without repeated clarification

criterias.name: Structured explanation
criterias.description: Ideas are presented in an organised manner
criterias.scoring_condition: The student uses clear sequencing (e.g. 'first… then…')

criterias.name: Diagrammatic support
criterias.scoring_condition: Relevant diagrams or sketches are drawn where appropriate

criterias.name: Labeling and notation
criterias.scoring_condition: Variables, axes, and diagrams are clearly labelled

criterias.name: Alignment of speech and writing
criterias.scoring_condition: Verbal explanation corresponds to what is written on the whiteboard

dimensions.name: Time Management
dimensions.description: Ability to engage promptly, maintain steady progress without long stalls, prioritise key steps, and reach a meaningful conclusion within the available time.

criterias.name: Prompt engagement
criterias.scoring_condition: The student begins framing or solving within a short time window

criterias.name: Steady progress
criterias.scoring_condition: No prolonged pauses without productive activity

criterias.name: Prioritisation
criterias.scoring_condition: Core steps are attempted before secondary details

criterias.name: Awareness of time
criterias.scoring_condition: The student adjusts pace when time is limited

criterias.name: Meaningful conclusion
criterias.scoring_condition: A result, partial result, or clear summary is reached
